source.title: ADREP taxonomy — ECCAIRS Aviation Data Definition Standard 1.3.0.12 (Attribute Values)
source.note: Only numeric ids, CICTT codes and short names are extracted (identifiers, no definitions or usage notes). ICAO states the taxonomy is being updated. Verify against the ICAO PDFs before citing.
